docs.title: BRIDGE Central Schema
docs.text:
The central BRIDGE schema for harmonized cross-BER data access. Defines shared base elements and composes domain modules (currently: measurements.yaml).

URI: https://w3id.org/ber-data/bridge-central-schema

Name: ber-central-schema
